title: PAH positive scalar beta and kappa_s transport cannot repair the free-vertex pullback
question: Can any strictly positive scalar transport of beta and kappa_s repair exact strong lumpability for the named PAH-FREE-VERTEX-RESTRICTION forgetful pullback?
decision_reason: The R-480 edge calculation gives DeltaF_1-DeltaF_2=-kappa_s*delta*(z_1-z_2). Under any fine beta>0 and kappa_s>0 transport, the hidden-state-independent aperture mobility cancels and the logarithmic rate defect is beta*kappa_s*delta*(z_1-z_2)/2, which is nonzero for a positive step and distinct hidden values. Therefore scalar beta or kappa_s rescaling cannot make the pullback generator fibre-constant. The result narrows the open Stage 2 choices without selecting a block map, conditional kernel, hidden weight or successor functional.
method: Pin immutable PAH-001 and separately versioned PAH-OMC-001 by raw-byte SHA-256 values.
Keep the displayed positive edge term and the named forgetful coarse map unchanged.
Derive the edge increment difference directly in the primary lane and by expanded linear cancellation in the independent lane.
Vary positive transported beta and kappa_s inputs over the declared exact rational test set and assert the factorized logarithmic rate defect is nonzero.
Run hostile degenerate and sign mutations to verify that positivity and distinctness are explicit hypotheses, then compile the Lean factorization/nonzero lemma.
finding: Primary and independent lanes each pass 1755/1755 exact rational transport cases, hostile review rejects 6/6 mutation checks, the integrated verifier passes 13/13, and Lean R481 compiles. The named forgetful pullback therefore remains non-intertwining for every tested positive scalar beta/kappa_s transport; the broader block, conditional-kernel, cell-weight and approximate-defect routes remain open. Stage 2 remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_scope: Route-local finite analytic boundary for PAH-001 plus PAH-OMC-001: one retained aperture vertex, one freely varying adjacent hidden vertex, the natural forgetful pullback, the unchanged positive kappa_s edge term, arbitrary positive scalar beta/kappa_s transport in the tested rational domain, external stochastic Markov time, and no limit.
evidence_level: T5 route-local exact algebra with primary, non-importing independent, hostile, integrated and Lean verification
assumptions: The retained aperture has a positive finite grid step and the hidden fibre contains two distinct aperture values.
Fine beta and kappa_s are strictly positive scalar transported values.
The retained aperture mobility is independent of the hidden aperture and no hidden-state-dependent term cancels the displayed edge defect.
Exact pullback intertwining is tested through strong lumpability on the pullback cylinder core.
missing_assumptions: A nontrivial owner-selected block or conditional-expectation morphism beyond the rejected forgetful pullback.
A complete parameter and cell-weight transport for that morphism.
A compatible move/root kernel and either exact intertwining or a preregistered uniform boundary-defect norm.
boundary: This is a route-local no-go for positive scalar beta/kappa_s rescaling of one already named pullback. It is not a global PAH no-go and does not address a weighted kernel, block map, conditional expectation or separately versioned functional.
non_claims: No PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 bytes, functional, move set, mobility exponent, projection, regulator or limit order are changed.
No nontrivial refinement or uniform limit is admitted.
No Markov time is identified with quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, event-horizon, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.

adversarial_review.check: Does the proof accidentally claim that negative or zero transported parameters are allowed?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: positive beta, positive kappa_s, positive aperture step and distinct hidden values are explicit; hostile zero cases are rejected as degenerate.

adversarial_review.check: Could a beta or kappa_s scalar rescaling cancel the fibre defect?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the factor is a product of nonzero positive scalars with the distinct hidden-value difference; Lean R481 proves it cannot vanish.

adversarial_review.check: Does this route-local result exclude a conditional kernel or a new successor functional?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS BOUNDARY ONLY: those constructions are outside the tested map and remain open under separate versioned ownership.

next_action: The owner must hash-pin one nontrivial block or conditional-expectation morphism with cell/parameter transport and a compatible move/root kernel, or explicitly supply a normalized defect norm; scalar beta/kappa_s rescaling is no longer an open repair route.
revisit_condition: Reopen Stage 2 only after a new owner morphism hash and its exact or uniform defect theorem pass primary, independent, hostile and formal checks.
stop_or_redesign: Do not infer a global PAH no-go from this route-local scalar-transport boundary.
Do not modify PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 in place.
Do not start spectral-collapse, trapped-transfer, physical-empty, Reading-H, continuum or observable-law calculations while nontrivial refinement remains unadmitted.
If a weighted kernel, block variable, counterterm or new dynamics is required, create a new separately versioned successor and restart its finite audit.
